title: luxo4k — RGBA & Conspiracy, 4K for Windows
author: RGBA & Conspiracy, PRISM
notes: A 4K made in 2007 for the San Francisco demoscene outreach tour, Pixar's Luxo Jr. lamp in under 4096 bytes: graphics by iq, sound by Gargaj, Crinkler-packed (this is Conspiracy's 2023 repack, from Conspiracy's own site). It draws with Direct3D 9's fixed function: D3DX meshes lit by Direct3D's lights, its title made by D3DXCreateText in "times", which Windows answers with Times New Roman (FontSubstitutes). MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_33.dll in JavaScript; the page reads the visitor's own Times New Roman (Chrome asks first) or uses DejaVu Serif.
